phase: Scenario A/B with the PROMPT FROZEN at v25. Eight rounds of prompt edits moved nothing because every cell has exactly one need - laundry - and it is met online from home. This asks whether a second need changes what the day can do.
primary: Count of meal_dine_in in the no-policy arm. It is 1 in 192 cells today, which is why the distancing restriction has nothing to suppress and DS-1 cannot reach its measured sign. Secondary: share of planned events at a zone anchor, stuck at 0.105 for six rounds.
limitations: The prompt is identical in both arms. This round cannot and does not select a prompt.
A need can only make a behaviour possible. It does not make the behaviour correct, and the answer-key indicators are reported, not used to choose.
Meal stock alternates 0/2 by sorted citizen index, the same rule the detergent uses. It is a scenario assumption.
More needs means more spending by construction; the composition distance to each citizen's own profile is checked so the arm cannot win by inflating.
Laundry plus a meal stock. home_meal now consumes food; groceries refill it; the meal may be had at home or away.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Closed pair fixed before the run (experiments/v9/prompt_v9.md). The arms differ only in the need model; the prompt, seeds, contracts and gate are the same.
